verses.text: Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', manhoknhej ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto chi' ix yik' winh, palta ayto juntzanhxo heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il ix yik' winh, haton heb' ix moabita, heb' ix amonita, heb' ix edomita, heb' ix aj Sidón yet' heb' ix hitita.

Yalnak Jehová to ay yowalil yik'lan sb'a heb' israel yet' juntzanh heb' ix chi', yik max montajb'at heb' yuj heb' ix t'a spatik juntzanh skomon diosal schonhab' heb' ix chi'. Palta haxo winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix kan snib'ej winh t'a heb' ix, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' heb' ix.
Ay 700 heb' ix yetb'eyum winh chi', yisil rey heb' ix. Ay pax 300 heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh yaji. Ha yuj heb' ix chi' ix juwiel spensar winh.

Haxo yik ix ichamwinakax winh, ix somchajb'at spensar winh yuj heb' ix. Ix montajb'at winh t'a spatik juntzanhxo komon Dios. Majxo yak'och spensar winh sik'lab'il t'a Jehová sDiosal icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj David smam winh.
Ix och winh ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Astoret, ix sdiosal heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a junxo komon Dios skuch Milcom, sdiosal heb' amonita. Ha juntzanh chi' te yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi', te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi', yujto manh k'anab'ajumoklaj ix yutej sb'a winh t'ay, manh lajanoklaj ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a winh smam chi'.

Ha t'a jun tzalan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, hata' ix sb'ok'e stemplo sdiosal heb' moabita winh, haton jun skuchan Quemos. Ix sb'opax stemplo sdiosal heb' amonita winh, haton jun skuch Moloc. Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' masanil heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il ix yik'a', yik syak' silab' heb' ix yet' incienso t'a sdiosal junjun.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a winhaj Salomón chi', yujto ix patikajkanel yuj winh, wach'chom chael sch'oxnak sb'a t'a winh.
Ix yal Jehová t'a winh to ay yowalil yoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, palta maj sk'anab'ajej winh sk'ulan tas ix yal Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Yujto icha tik ix a k'ulej, maj a k'anab'ajej in trato yet' in cheknab'il walnak t'ayach, yuj chi' ol wik'ek' opisio tik, ol wak'an t'a junok heb' a chekab'.
Palta yujto xajan winh a mam wuuj, yuj chi' yakb'an pitzanachto, manh ol wik'ek'laj opisio tik, palta ha t'a jun uninal, hata' ol wik'eq'ui.
Manh ol wik'ek' yopisio chi' smasanil. Olto kan junok makan t'a yol sk'ab' yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wuuj yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik, yujto sik'b'ilel wuuj, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun winh ajk'ool t'a winhaj Salomón chi', haton winhaj Hadad yinhtilalkan heb' winh sreyal Edom.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik yak'annak ganar chonhab' Edom chi' winhaj rey David, a winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado b'at yet' jun makan heb' soldado Israel, yik b'at smukan heb' chamnak heb', wake' ujal kan heb' ta'. Yakb'an chi', swach' milancham masanil heb' winh winak aj Edom chi' heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', yune' kelemto winhaj Hadad chi', palta elkan lemnaj winh, b'atkan winh yet' juntzanh heb' schekab' winh smam, sb'atkan heb' t'a Egipto.

El heb' t'a Madián, sk'och heb' t'a Parán. Hata' yik'b'at juntzanhxo heb' winh winak heb', sk'ochkan heb' t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Hata' ak'ji spat heb', swael heb' yet' slum heb' yuj winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Hadad chi', te wach' snaan winh rey chi' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' yak' jun ix smu' winh rey chi' yetb'eyumok winh, haton ix snulej ix reina Tahpenes.
Yalji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hadad chi', Genubat yak' ix sb'iej. Ha ix Tahpenes chi' ilan q'uib' jun unin chi' t'a spalacio winh rey chi', junnhej q'uib'nak yet' heb' yuninal winh rey chi'.

Haxo yik yab'an spekal winhaj Hadad t'a Egipto chi' to a winhaj rey David chamnakxo winh, chamnakxo pax winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado, yalan winh icha tik t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi': --Cha in meltzaj t'a in chonhab', xchi winh.

Stak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tzach meltzaj t'a a chonhab' chi'? ¿Tom ay tas syak' palta t'ayach wuuj? xchi winh. Stak'wi winhaj Hadad chi': --Tz'akan yaj masanil t'ayin uuj, palta tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a cha meltzajok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' chaji meltzaj winh yuj winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Hadad chi' ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ay junxo winh skuchan Rezón yuninal winhaj Eliada, ha Dios ix ak'anoch t'a spensar winh, ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Salomón chi'. Ha winhaj Rezón chi' elnak lemnaj winh t'a winh sreyal, haton winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba.

Ayik yak'jinak ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba chi' yet' smiljicham heb' soldado winh yuj winhaj rey David, a winhaj Rezón chi' smolb'ej jun nhilanh heb' elk'um winh, yoch winh yajalok heb'. Sb'atkan kajan winh yet' heb' soldado chi' t'a Damasco, hata' ak'jioch winh reyal yuj heb'.
Ix te och winh ajk'olal t'a chonhab' Israel ayik ayoch winhaj Salomón chi' reyal, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Hadad sreyal Edom.

Ay pax junxo winh ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winhaj Salomón chi', ix meltzajoch winh ajk'olal t'a winh. Haton winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat aj Sere t'a yinhtilal heb' Efraín. Chamnakxo smam winh chi', haxo ix snun winh, Serúa sb'i ix.
Icha wal tik ix aj spitzwichaanh owal yuj winh: Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi' ix chekan b'ut'jok jun ch'olan yik wach' schalaj sb'a smuroal schonhab' winhaj rey David.
Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi' te nhikan winh, ayik ix yilan winh rey chi' to te ay yelk'och winh t'a sat heb' yetchonhab', ix yak'anoch winh yajalil t'a heb' munlajwum yinhtilalkan José.

Ha junel ix elta winhaj Jeroboam chi' t'a stiel Jerusalén chi', k'okb'il ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Ahías schekab' Dios, aj Silo. Ayoch jun sjukan pichul winhaj Ahías chi', te ak'to. Ix lolon heb' winh sch'okoj schawanhil.
Ix yik'anel jun sjukan pichul winhaj Ahías chi', lajchawe' ix yutej winh snhik'chitanb'ati.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Jeroboam chi' icha tik: Cha lajunheok iko', yujto icha tik syal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach: Ol wik'ek' smakb'en winhaj Salomón, haxo t'ayach ol wak' lajunheok inhtilal.
Palta yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wuuj yet' pax chonhab' Jerusalén sik'b'ilel wuuj t'a skal masanil chonhab' Israel, yuj chi' olto wak'kan junok inhtilal t'a yinhtilal winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi' ix in yaktejkan winh, ix och winh ejmelal t'a Astarté, ix sdiosal heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' t'a Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Te manhxa swach'il tas syutej sb'a winh t'a wichanh, maxtzak sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al winh yet' in cheknab'il. Manh ichok yutejnak sb'a winhaj David smam winh, manh ichokta' syutej sb'a winh.
Palta yakb'an pitzanto winh, manh ol wik'ek'laj yopisio winh tik t'a reyal. Yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wuuj to in sik'nakel winh, sk'anab'ajejnak wal in cheknab'il winh yet' in k'ayb'ub'al.
Palta ha t'a jun winh yuninal winhaj Salomón chi' ol wik'ek' lajunheok inhtilal, ol wak'an t'ayach.
Junxonhej inhtilal ol wak'kan t'a winh yik wach' ayto mach ol naankot winh in chekab' aj David t'a wichanh t'a Jerusalén tik, haton jun chonhab' in sik'nakkanel b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin.
Ol ach wak'och reyal t'a yib'anh tas tza nib'ej, haton chonhab' Israel.

Yuj chi', tato ol a k'anab'ajej masanil tas tzin chek a k'ulej tik, tato tojolnhej pax ol utej a b'a t'a wichanh, tato ol a k'anab'ajejnhej in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il, icha yutejnak sb'a winh in chekab' aj David, tato icha chi', ayinnhej ek' het'ok. Ol wak'nhej opisio, icha ajnak wak'an yopisio winh in chekab' aj David chi', ol wak'anoch chonhab' Israel tik t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winhaj David junok tiempoal yujnhej smul winhaj Salomón chi', palta manh ol wak'kanochlaj t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová t'ayach, xchi winhaj Ahías chi'.

Ha yuj tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix snib'ej winhaj Salomón smilcham winhaj Jeroboam chi'. Yuj chi' ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a Egipto b'aj ayoch winhaj Sisac reyal. Ix kannhej winh ta' masanto ix cham winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha yab'ixal juntzanhxo tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Salomón chi' yet' sjelanil winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal winh.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab' Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukchaj winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David winh smam. Ixlajwi chi' haxo jun yuninal winh skuchan Roboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
